title: Lilac Mesh Top & Metal Belt
prompt: An original young woman with long, straight black hair falls past her shoulders and wears layered silver necklaces. She wears a lilac long-sleeve mesh top with a scoop neckline, a sheer lace-trimmed bodice with small floral embroidery, and a center zip. A wide embellished metal belt sits low over dark flare jeans. Pointed silver-toned shoes complete the look. Her expression is calm and direct. Soft, even studio light. Palette of lilac, charcoal denim, and silver. Playful and delicate, in the style of a Y2K lookbook.
workingNotes:
- The sheer lace bodice and metal belt are the signature details.
- Keep the flare jeans for a retro silhouette.
